in_hebrew.name: פּרינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'pera' meaning 'to exalt, magnify, or be abundant.' The name 'Perrine' could be interpreted as 'the exalted one' or 'the precious one.' In the Bible, this name is not explicitly mentioned, but it is similar in meaning to 'Esther' (הַסְתֵּר, 'hidden, star').

in_greek.name: Περρίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'perrinos' or 'perrinon', meaning 'exalted, precious, or abundant'. In the New Testament, there is a character named 'Perineus' or 'Perennis' (Περιννος, Περιννος), who is mentioned as a witness to the resurrection of Christ. However, it is unclear if this character is related to the name 'Perrine'.

in_latin.name: Perrina
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'perrinus' or 'perrina', meaning 'exalted, precious, or abundant'. There is no direct biblical reference to this name in Latin, but it could be a derivative of the Latin word 'perrinus' which is mentioned in the Vulgate translation of the Bible in reference to the character Perineus in the New Testament.
